answer: Make each agent identity earn its standing with a small refundable stake tied to completed work. A new agent puts down a deposit, then must finish a set of real paid jobs before it can trade freely. If it cheats, the deposit is slashed and the identity starts from zero. An attacker who wants a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand deposits and a thousand job histories. Think of a lagoon with one narrow channel to the sea: boats wander in one at a time, so no one can flood the island market overnight by cloning a fleet. The stake turns a cheap copy into an expensive one.
